$comment: Pre-existing problems that existed BEFORE the M0 safety net was added. Static checkers do not fail on these; they fail on anything NEW. Remove an entry when the underlying issue is fixed. Do not add entries to hide new problems.

hardcodedSitePrefix.note: Files that hard-code the GitHub Pages path (/Toolzenhub) or host (salar500.github.io) in source. The checker fails if a NEW file starts hard-coding it. Target architecture: derive everything from one site config.

files.reason: M2: the single source of the GitHub Pages host, base path and production URL. routes.js, footer.js and article-seo.js now import it.
